questions.stem: What does ADH stand for and where is it released from?

options.text: Anti-dehydration hormone, released from the kidneys
Antidiuretic hormone, released from the pituitary gland
Antidiuretic hormone, released from the adrenal glands
Anti-dehydration hormone, released from the hypothalamus

questions.explanation: ADH stands for antidiuretic hormone. It is produced by the hypothalamus but stored and released from the pituitary gland into the blood when the body needs to conserve water.
